extractor: read from the Immigration Services Agency page registered in source_roles, fetched from the VPS with the source monitor's own User-Agent
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from, verbatim and in Japanese. Labels and descriptions are VisaAI's English and are ours, not the authority's — the Sweden precedent, where the authority's own language is quoted and English labels are marked as translations. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs issues the visa and refuses our monitor; nothing about the visa application procedure is recorded here.
structure_note: THE PERIOD OF STAY IS NOT A FIXED SET. Unlike the working statuses, which offer four or six fixed options, the student period is designated individually by the Minister of Justice within a ceiling of 4 years and 3 months. The status also reaches far below university — elementary and lower-secondary schools are named in the definition.
freshness_note: The page publishes no dateModified in its markup and is reported as unknown, never as fresh.
not_extracted: The visa application procedure and the visa fee. Japan splits status from visa: the Immigration Services Agency grants the residence status, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs issues the visa at an embassy or consulate, and www.mofa.go.jp returns HTTP 403 on robots.txt to our monitor. Nothing about obtaining the visa is recorded.
The 上陸許可基準 (landing permission criteria). Linked from the page as a PDF rather than stated in the served HTML. Not fetched and not paraphrased.

The per-category document lists. ISA sorts employing organisations or institutions into categories and the required documents differ by category; those lists run to dozens of branching items and are not enumerated here.
Processing times. Not stated on the page.

requirements.label: The qualifying activity: education at a Japanese university, college of technology, high school, special-needs upper department, lower-secondary school, elementary school, specialised training college, miscellaneous school, or an equivalent institution
requirements.description: The status covers school education as well as higher education, which is unusual and is what makes it available to accompanying school-age children in their own right.
requirements.source_excerpt: 本邦の大学、高等専門学校、高等学校（中等教育学校の後期課程を含む。）若しくは特別支援学校の高等部、中学校（義務教育学校の後期課程及び中等教育学校の前期課程を含む。）若しくは特別支援学校の中学部、小学校（義務教育学校の前期課程を含む。）若しくは特別支援学校の小学部、専修学校若しくは各種学校又は設備及び編制に関してこれらに準ずる機関において教育を受ける活動。
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 本邦の大学、高等専門学校、高等学校（中等教育学校の後期課程を含む。）若しくは特別支援学校の高等部、中学校（義務教育学校の後期課程及び中等教育学校の前期課程を含む。）若しくは特別支援学校の中学部、小学校（義務教育学校の前期課程を含む。）若しくは特別支援学校の小学部、専修学校若しくは各種学校又は設備及び編制に関してこれらに準ずる機関において教育を受ける活動。

requirements.label: Examples the authority gives: students at universities, junior colleges, colleges of technology, high schools, lower-secondary and elementary schools
requirements.source_excerpt: 該当例としては、大学、短期大学、高等専門学校、高等学校、中学校及び小学校等の学生・生徒。
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 該当例としては、大学、短期大学、高等専門学校、高等学校、中学校及び小学校等の学生・生徒。

requirements.label: Period of stay: designated individually by the Minister of Justice, within a ceiling of 4 years and 3 months
requirements.description: Not a menu of fixed terms. The ceiling is the only published number.
requirements.source_excerpt: 在留期間 法務大臣が個々に指定する期間（４年３月を超えない範囲）
